req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-009 requires POST /players/ to return HTTP 422 when the request body fails PlayerRequestModel schema validation. The PlayerRequestModel has three required (non-Optional) fields: first_name, last_name, position, and squad_number. Tests must cover: (1) a positive case with a fully valid payload that is accepted (EP), (2) negative cases where required fields are missing or have wrong types (NEG/DT), and (3) boundary cases at the exact edge of what Pydantic accepts vs rejects (BVA). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact status code 422 (not >= 400), asserting the exact 201 for the positive case, and checking response body structure for error detail keys. Squad numbers used for positive tests must not conflict with the 26 pre-loaded rows (1-26), so we use squad number 99 for new inserts.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Database contains pre-loaded rows with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload (all required fields present, squad_number=99)
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, position, squadNumber, and id fields
trace: R-PLAYER-009: valid payload must NOT trigger 422; it must succeed with 201
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201()

tests.name: test_post_player_missing_first_name_returns_422
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Request body omits the required field first_name
actions: POST /players/ with payload missing firstName (required field)
expected: Response body contains 'detail' key with validation error information
trace: R-PLAYER-009: missing required field first_name must trigger HTTP 422
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_missing_first_name_returns_422():
    payload = {
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    errors = body["detail"]
    assert isinstance(errors, list)
    assert len(errors) >= 1
    field_names = [e["loc"][-1] for e in errors if "loc" in e]
    assert "first_name" in field_names or "firstName" in field_names

test_post_player_missing_first_name_returns_422()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_with_all_optional_fields_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Full",
        "middleName": "Middle",
        "lastName": "Fields",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 97,
        "position": "Centre-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "CB",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Full"
    assert body["middleName"] == "Middle"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Fields"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 97
    assert body["position"] == "Centre-Back"
    assert body["starting11"] is True
    assert r.headers["location"] == "/players/squadnumber/97"

test_post_player_with_all_optional_fields_returns_201()
